purpose_zh: 把合成群组仿真信号翻译成重点区、时段和责任角色可复核的空间动作。
purpose_en: Translate synthetic group-screen signals into reviewable spatial actions by key area, time window and accountable role.

population_reference.boundary: This is a scale reference for a synthetic replay, not a local trip count or survey.

geometry_boundary.anchor_caveat: PROV-KEY-003 remains an inherited provisional polygon and is not a Dazhongsi station buffer.

policy.release_rule: Synthetic screening can propose a review question. A named professional and dated local evidence must release a spatial action.

model_can_do: expose mode competition and worst-group guards
identify missing evidence before a pilot
human_must_decide: whether a curb or route change is safe and lawful
whether an accessible equivalent route is present
whether a named operator can staff and restore the service
whether local residents and affected operators have been heard

cells.spatial_problem_zh: 企业到岗、班车并入和站口步行在同一早高峰争用路缘。
cells.spatial_problem_en: Enterprise arrival, feeder merging and station-side walking compete for the same morning curb.
cells.spatial_action_zh: 只把企业候车、骑行停放和装卸划成短时可清场窗口，保留连续人行线和消防净空。
cells.spatial_action_en: Mark short, clearable windows for enterprise waiting, bicycle parking and loading while preserving the continuous footway and fire clearance.
cells.human_decision_question_zh: 现场交通与无障碍复核能否证明班车窗口不会切断公共路线？
cells.human_decision_question_en: Can field traffic and accessibility review show that the feeder window will not cut the public route?
cells.stop_condition: Stop and return to metro, bus and human guidance if the accessible route or fire clearance is interrupted.

cells.spatial_problem_zh: 装卸、访客和居民经过性步行需要同一条企业边界。
cells.spatial_problem_en: Loading, visitors and through-walking share the enterprise edge during service hours.
cells.spatial_action_zh: 把装卸预约和访客下客放进可撤回时窗，设置人工引导和不依赖 App 的路缘牌。
cells.spatial_action_en: Place loading and visitor drop-off inside reversible windows with human guidance and curb signs that do not depend on an app.
cells.human_decision_question_zh: 责任人、清场时限和投诉回写是否已经在现场可执行？
cells.human_decision_question_en: Are an owner, clearing time and complaint writeback executable on site?
cells.stop_condition: Hold the window if delivery or visitor queues spill into the accessible route or public road.

cells.spatial_problem_zh: 企业下班、班车回程和社区方向步行在入口形成反向冲突。
cells.spatial_problem_en: Enterprise release, feeder return trips and community-bound walking create opposing flows at the entrance.
cells.spatial_action_zh: 先做分向导流和站口人工接管，班车只在公共交通余量与回家保障同时可见时进入复核。
cells.spatial_action_en: Start with directional separation and staffed station handoff; review feeders only when public-transport capacity and guaranteed return are both visible.
cells.human_decision_question_zh: 最慢群体和夜间回家链是否比全体平均值更安全？
cells.human_decision_question_en: Is the slowest group and its return-home chain safer than the all-group average suggests?
cells.stop_condition: Stop feeder expansion when return-home coverage or accessible transfer worsens.

cells.spatial_problem_zh: 夜班人员、维护物流和无障碍归家需要不同的安全服务窗口。
cells.spatial_problem_en: Night workers, maintenance logistics and accessible return trips need different safe service windows.
cells.spatial_action_zh: 夜间只保留有人值守的公共交通和连续步行回退，不开放未经授权的自动接驳。
cells.spatial_action_en: At night keep staffed public-transport and continuous walking fallback only; do not open an unauthorized automated feeder.
cells.human_decision_question_zh: 谁在末班车、照明、维修和拒载时段承担现场接手？
cells.human_decision_question_en: Who takes over on site at the last service, lighting, repair and refusal points?
cells.stop_condition: Hold the night window when a staffed and accessible return path is not documented.

cells.spatial_problem_zh: 上学、照护、企业出行和轮椅通行共享社区入口。
cells.spatial_problem_en: School, care, enterprise travel and wheelchair movement share the community entrance.
cells.spatial_action_zh: 先画连续坡道、照护停靠和人工服务台，任何数字预约都不改变公共通行。
cells.spatial_action_en: First mark the continuous ramp, care drop-off and human service desk; digital booking must not change public access.
cells.human_decision_question_zh: 儿童、照护者和轮椅使用者是否拥有同等清晰的替代路线？
cells.human_decision_question_en: Do children, carers and wheelchair users have equally clear alternative routes?
cells.stop_condition: Hold any curb change when the accessible route is longer, less safe or dependent on a digital account.

cells.spatial_problem_zh: 就医、买菜、快递和社区维护在日间路缘叠加。
cells.spatial_problem_en: Medical, grocery, parcel and community maintenance trips overlap at the daytime curb.
cells.spatial_action_zh: 将医疗和照护下客与快递装卸分开登记，保留无需预约的人工通道。
cells.spatial_action_en: Register medical and care drop-off separately from parcel loading while retaining an unreserved human passage.
cells.human_decision_question_zh: 服务台能否在高峰时段解释、记录并纠正一次冲突？
cells.human_decision_question_en: Can the service desk explain, record and correct one conflict during the peak window?
cells.stop_condition: Stop a booking rule if it displaces an urgent care trip or blocks the public route.

cells.spatial_problem_zh: 居民回家、学生接送和企业接驳在社区边界叠加。
cells.spatial_problem_en: Resident return, school pick-up and enterprise feeders overlap at the community edge.
cells.spatial_action_zh: 把学生接送、居民步行和企业下客分成不同窗口，先验证人工导流再谈合并。
cells.spatial_action_en: Separate school pick-up, resident walking and enterprise drop-off windows; test staffed guidance before consolidation.
cells.human_decision_question_zh: 分组导流是否减少最弱群体的等待与绕行，而非只减少车辆排队？
cells.human_decision_question_en: Does grouped guidance reduce waiting and detours for the most exposed group, not only vehicle queues?
cells.stop_condition: Stop if the accessible or child-safe route loses priority during the release window.

cells.spatial_problem_zh: 夜班、老年人和照护回家需要照明、人工询问与连续无障碍路径。
cells.spatial_problem_en: Night return for shift workers, older residents and carers needs lighting, human help and a continuous accessible path.
cells.spatial_action_zh: 建立夜间人工服务点和照明巡检回执，公共交通失效时只启用地面人工回退。
cells.spatial_action_en: Establish a night human-service point and lighting inspection receipt; use staffed ground fallback when transit fails.
cells.human_decision_question_zh: 夜间回家链是否有可见的责任人、替代路线和退出条件？
cells.human_decision_question_en: Does the night return chain show an owner, an alternative route and a stop condition?
cells.stop_condition: Stop if the night route lacks lighting, human handoff or an accessible alternative.

cells.spatial_problem_zh: 轨道换乘、骑行停放和企业到岗关系受临时锚点限制。
cells.spatial_problem_en: Rail transfer, bicycle parking and enterprise arrival are constrained by the provisional anchor.
cells.spatial_action_zh: 只画换乘关系和调查任务，不把临时多边形当作站点缓冲区，不发布工程位置。
cells.spatial_action_en: Draw only the transfer relationship and survey tasks; do not treat the provisional polygon as a station buffer or publish an engineering location.
cells.human_decision_question_zh: 维护者是否先发布正式锚定关系，再允许任何站口空间动作？
cells.human_decision_question_en: Has the maintainer published an official anchor relationship before any station-side spatial action is allowed?
cells.stop_condition: Hold all geometry-led action until the key-area anchor and station relation are formally confirmed.

cells.spatial_problem_zh: 访客、装卸和轨道站口服务可能共享同一临时关系线。
cells.spatial_problem_en: Visitors, loading and station-side service may share the same provisional relationship line.
cells.spatial_action_zh: 把活动日、装卸和站口调查分开，先做公共空间观察与无障碍复核。
cells.spatial_action_en: Separate event-day, loading and station surveys; begin with public-space observation and accessibility review.
cells.human_decision_question_zh: 临时关系线能否支持调查而不诱导错误的站点建设结论？
cells.human_decision_question_en: Can the provisional relationship support a survey without inducing a false station-building conclusion?
cells.stop_condition: Hold any fixed intervention if the geometry or public-space ownership remains unclear.

cells.spatial_problem_zh: 跨边界通勤、活动日人流和居民归家需要不同的换乘与路缘规则。
cells.spatial_problem_en: Cross-boundary commuting, event flows and resident return require different transfer and curb rules.
cells.spatial_action_zh: 把跨边界 OD、活动日人流和居民回家分别记录，禁止用合成排序替代现场容量。
cells.spatial_action_en: Record cross-boundary OD, event flows and resident return separately; do not use synthetic ranking as a substitute for field capacity.
cells.human_decision_question_zh: 轨道优先、居民回家和无障碍连续性是否在同一时段都被保住？
cells.human_decision_question_en: Are rail priority, resident return and accessible continuity all protected in the same window?
cells.stop_condition: Hold feeder or event changes when external OD and the worst-group route are not measured.

cells.spatial_problem_zh: 夜间轨道接驳、装卸维护和跨边界回家均受临时空间关系与安全证据约束。
cells.spatial_problem_en: Night rail connection, maintenance loading and cross-boundary return are constrained by provisional geometry and safety evidence.
cells.spatial_action_zh: 夜间只保留地面公共交通、人行回退和人工安全检查，空中候选保持零代理。
cells.spatial_action_en: At night keep ground public transport, walking fallback and staffed safety checks; keep the air candidate at zero agents.
cells.human_decision_question_zh: 正式锚点、末班车回退和夜间安全责任是否同时成立？
cells.human_decision_question_en: Are the official anchor, last-service fallback and night safety responsibility all in place?
cells.stop_condition: Hold the night action when any anchor, service, safety or human handoff is missing.
